amelia (PM): ok team — kickoff for a small playbook: onboarding community model variants + migration/deprecation flow. want to align launch checklist and who owns each step.
sohrab (Eng Lead): quick q — are we talking hosted-only or dedicated/private too?
lina (ML Researcher): all of the above ideally. benchmarks differ but the flow should be shared: ingest -> perf/accuracy suite -> pinning policy -> rollout.
marcus (Customer Success): customer asks: ability to pin to a specific model hash and get a deprecation ETA when we move them. they want a migration window and fallback behavior.
amelia (PM): yep — want a single doc + a tiny UI flow. initial scope: hosted + dedicated. private can follow with config knobs. here's a minimal launch criteria I had in mind:
```
- onboarding: artifact upload + metadata (arch, vocab, quantization)
- benchmarks: latency P50/P95, mem, quality eval (ctl prompts)
- model profile created and surfaced in catalog
- pinning: per-customer pin to model version/hash
- migration: deprecation notice + 30d migration window + automated fallback to pinned variant
- security/compliance checks (license, export)
- docs + migration guide + telemetry hooks
```
sohrab (Eng Lead): sounds reasonable. two implementation questions: 1) how strict is "pin to model hash" — do we allow minor config changes (quant vs int8) under same pin? 2) what triggers automated fallback?
lina (ML Researcher): for 1) prefer pin to model digest + allowed-compatibility-tags array, e.g., you can allow same-arch int8 variants but not different topology. for 2) fallback = runtime mismatch (OOM) or quality/regression alerts. fallback rule should be configurable per-route.
amelia (PM): propose default: pin -> model_digest. allow compatibility tags like ["quantized:int8","kv-cache-compatible"]. if a new variant fails perf or eval thresholds we auto-fallback to last-good. users get an email + console banner.
marcus (Customer Success): please include a migration notification workflow: 14d notice, in-console opt-in to auto-migrate, and a one-click revert for 7d post-migration. customers asked for these.
sohrab (Eng Lead): implementation sketch:
```
catalog_entry: {
  model_digest: "sha256:abcd...",
  variants: ["v1-int8","v1-fp16"],
  compatibility_tags: ["kv-cache-compatible"]
}
route_config: {
  pinned_digest: "sha256:abcd...",
  allow_compat_tags: ["quantized:int8"]
}
```
we can enforce digest equality for strict pin, or allow tag matching for relaxed pin.
lina (ML Researcher): benchmarks: I'll contribute an eval harness. baseline set = current hosted defaults. We'll run a 1000-prompt suite covering safety, hallucination, instruction-following. Need perf profiles for typical seq lengths (64,256,1024).
amelia (PM): owners: lina -> bench harness + thresholds; sohrab -> runtime + pinning implementation + fallback plumbing; marcus -> customer comms & migration UX copy; me -> product doc + launch checklist.
dev-bot: snapshot created: catalog-snap-2025-01-21T08:00Z (id: snap-1752003400)
sohrab (Eng Lead): timeline? can we get an MVP in 3 sprints? 2 sprints for core plumbing + 1 sprint for tests/docs/UX polish.
amelia (PM): agree. target alpha: 2025-02-28. tradeoffs: skip private deploy UI in alpha, provide CLI and config file for private for now.
marcus (Customer Success): I'll line up 2 pilot customers who asked for pinning. they'll validate migration notices and fallback behavior.
lina (ML Researcher): one more: add regression alerts tied to a labeled prompt set per customer so we can detect semantic drift post-migration.
amelia (PM): good call. add as "quality monitoring" in launch criteria.
sohrab (Eng Lead): I'll file infra story for KV-cache compatibility checks and incrementally add compatibility tag verifications.
amelia (PM): action items recap (short):
- lina: bench harness + thresholds + regression alert hooks
- sohrab: pinning API + fallback + compatibility-tag enforcement
- marcus: pilot customers + UX copy for migration notices
- amelia: product doc, release checklist, metrics to track
I'll update the roadmap ticket and add acceptance criteria. any blockers? :eyes:
marcus (Customer Success): none from CS, just confirm timelines so customers know when to expect pilot. :+1:
sohrab (Eng Lead): raise one risk: model digest proliferation. we should add a cleanup policy and TTL for unused variants.
amelia (PM): (typo) amelia (PM): noted — add deprecation policy doc: auto-deprecate unused variants after 90d no traffic, notify owners 30d prior.
sohrab (Eng Lead): sweet. ok i'll start the pinning PR and link it here.
amelia (PM): thanks all — will post the first draft of the playbook by EOD tomorrow and tag owners. :party_popper:
